newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Corfivalle Q1 net down 50.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Corfivalle Q1 net down 50.4 pct.

text.p: BOGOTA, May 7 Reuter - Colombia's Corfivalle, the largest finance corporation in terms of assets, posted the following first-quarter results, the banking superintendency said Wednesday:
Net profits Q1 1997 9.4 billion pesos vs 18.95 bilion pesos in Q1 1996.
Total assets Q1 1997 1.65 trillion pesos vs 1.31 trillion pesos.
The banking superintendency said the fall in net profits was due to a 50.8 percent increase in the corporation's bad debt provision, up from 15.6 billion pesos to 23.6 billion pesos.
